title: Fourier substitution coefficients
statement: Let $p:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$. For each $T\\subseteq[n]$, define its substitution coefficient by $(-2)^{|T|}\\sum_{S\\supseteq T}\\widehat p(S)$, where $\\widehat p(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $p$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
